answer: Pay agent services from a quadratic matching pool, but bound it pairwise: each pair of backers has its joint subsidy scaled by k/(k+overlap), where overlap counts past epochs they funded the same targets. An honest backer of a reef-survey agent adds about one unit of match. A farm of 20 clones that always co-fund one trellis of fake projects forms 190 high-overlap pairs, so its match collapses toward one backer while it still pays 20 contributions. Clones that randomize targets to hide overlap scatter across an ocean of honest projects and lose their concentration.
